_comment: HT160S WhiteList sort-mode sample. Deploy as HT160S_WhiteList\WhiteList.json under the HT160S working dir (fixed folder + fixed file name). In By WhiteList mode this file is the authoritative 2D->Bin source (loaded at Lot Start, replacing the WebAPI pull). Only 2D codes listed here are sorted, each to its listed Bin (routed through the static Bin->Auto recipe table, same as Normal mode); any scanned 2D code NOT in this list is sent silently to the Error bin. LotNumber MUST match the lot declared by the host (SET_LOT_INFO/LOTSTART) or entered by the operator, else Start is blocked. 2D codes are byte-exact (case-sensitive) and must be unique across the file. The _comment key is ignored by the parser.
